title: Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution

body: The order in which an elementary reaction's energy profile proceeds along the reaction coordinate.

control: hook expansion swapped (first order mapped to 1/[A] and second order to ln[A]); entry itself correct. CED p.96 5.3.A.2 checked: 'If a reaction is first order ... a plot of the natural log (ln) of the reactant concentration as a function of time will be linear.' and 5.3.A.3: 'If a reaction is second order ... a plot of the reciprocal of the concentration of that reactant versus time will be linear.'
title: Which concentration-versus-time plot is linear for each order
body: The plot that gives a straight line identifies the reaction order with respect to the monitored reactant.

hooks.when_to_use: when deciding which plot to make to identify reaction order
hooks.caution: On the exam, name the plot and the order explicitly (e.g. 'ln[A] versus time is linear, so the reaction is first order').
